title: 128 wild elephant deaths reported so far this year
byline: A total of 128 wild elephant deaths have been reported so far this year, according to the Department of Wildlife Conservation.

title: US charges Cuba’s Raúl Castro with murder over 1996 downing of two planes
byline: The US has charged former Cuban leader Raúl Castro with conspiracy to kill US nationals and other crimes over the 1996 downing of two planes between Cuba and Florida.

title: Govt. to give special attention to rural roads, drinking water supply and waste management in next budget
byline: Special attention will be given in the forthcoming Budget towards the development of rural roads, the provision of drinking water and resolving waste management issues, President Anura Kumara Dissanayake has stated.

title: South-west monsoon brings heavy rain and strong winds across Sri Lanka
byline: The South-West monsoon is gradually establishing over the island, bringing showers and strong winds to several parts of the country, according to the Department of Meteorology.

title: Sri Lanka to elevate its engagement with the Shanghai Cooperation Organization
byline: The Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism, Vijitha Herath held productive discussions with the Secretary-General of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) Nurlan Yermekbayev at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism.

title: RDA engineers launch indefinite trade union action over unmet demands
byline: The Engineers’ Association of the Road Development Authority (RDA) has announced that it has launched an indefinite trade union action from today (21), citing two key demands including a salary anomaly issue.

title: Trump says willing to wait for a few days to get ‘right answer’ on Iran peace deal
byline: US President Donald Trump on Wednesday (May 20) said the United States was ready to proceed with further attacks on Tehran if Iran did not agree to a peace deal, but suggested Washington could wait a few days to “get the right answers”.

title: Ebola vaccine could take nine months as death toll rises further, WHO warns
byline: The World Health Organization (WHO) says it could take up to nine months before a vaccine against this particular species of Ebola is ready.

title: Two killed in separate incidents in Seeduwa and Grandpass
byline: Police have launched investigations into two separate murder incidents reported in Seeduwa and Grandpass, in which two individuals have died.

title: Police freeze assets of couple over alleged drug trafficking via instant money transfers
byline: Police have frozen assets belonging to a married couple accused of trafficking narcotics through instant money transfer systems.

title: 42 antique paintings missing from National Art Gallery — Minister
byline: A total of 42 antique paintings from the National Art Gallery have been reported missing, Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs Hiniduma Sunil Senevi told Parliament.

title: Govt. to lift energy restrictions for Vesak Week
byline: The government has decided to lift the regulations previously imposed on the use of fuel and electricity in view of the Vesak festival, according to the Office of the Prime Minister.

title: Sri Lankan Rupee slumps as Asia’s worst-performing currency this month
byline: The Sri Lankan rupee has been identified as the worst-performing currency in Asia this month, according to a report published by a leading global business news platform.

title: Kylie Minogue battled cancer for a second time in secret
byline: Kylie Minogue battled cancer for a second time in secret after being diagnosed in 2021.

title: One in three Japan firms using or considering AI robots: Reuters poll
byline: One-third of Japanese companies are already using or considering deploying AI-powered robots, with automakers and other transportation equipment manufacturers leading the way, a Reuters survey showed on Thursday.

title: UK eases sanctions on Russian jet fuel and diesel imports
byline: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer defended Wednesday (May 20) a contentious move to ease sanctions on imports of Russian jet fuel and diesel as the Middle East war causes prices to spiral.

title: SC issues ruling against Secretary of Transport Ministry over fundamental rights case
byline: The Supreme Court has ruled that the Secretary of the Ministry of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation, Professor Kapila Perera, violated the fundamental human rights of Additional Secretary W.S. Sathyananda by declaring that his services were no longer required and subjecting him to humiliation and mental distress.

title: Govt. expects US$700 million IMF tranche on May 27 — Deputy Minister
byline: The government is hopeful of receiving US$700 million from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) on May 27, the Deputy Minister of Finance and Planning, (Prof.) Anil Jayantha Fernando has stated.

title: India mulls all options, including rate hike, as rupee slumps
byline: The Reserve Bank of India is considering all of its available options to stabilise the rupee, including an interest rate hike, more currency swaps and raising dollars from investors overseas, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Tamil Nadu CM Joseph Vijay expands his Cabinet
byline: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Joseph Vijay expanded his Cabinet today with the induction of 23 MLAs in the Council of Ministers. 21 MLAs from Vijay’s TVK party and 2 from the ally Congress took oath as ministers in the new government.

title: Govt. will not seek electricity tariff hike until September — Minister
byline: The government will not request an increase in electricity tariffs from the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka (PUCSL) until September, according to the Minister of Energy, Anura Karunathilaka.

title: US Dollar selling rate surpasses Rs. 350
byline: The Sri Lankan Rupee continues to weaken against the US Dollar amidst multiple factors including the ongoing conflict in the Middle East.

title: Luxury cruise ship makes maiden call at Colombo Port carrying over 2,300 tourists
byline: A luxury passenger cruise ship named ‘‘Mein Schiff 6’’, carrying 2,380 tourists, has arrived at the Colombo Port and docked at the East Container Terminal Stage (ECT).

title: PM Harini hold talks British Foreign Secretary
byline: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya has held a bilateral meeting with Yvette Cooper MP, the Foreign Secretary of the United Kingdom.

title: BTS to make special appearance at 2026 American Music Awards
byline: K-pop superstars BTS will make a “special appearance” at the 2026 American Music Awards (AMAs), organisers CBS and Dick Clark Productions announced on Wednesday (May 20).

title: Trump says he will speak to Taiwan’s president in break from protocol
byline: US President Donald Trump says he will talk to Taiwanese leader Lai Ching-te about a possible arms sale, in what would be a sharp departure from diplomatic tradition.

title: One in three Sri Lankans suffers from high blood pressure — Health Ministry
byline: One in every three people in Sri Lanka is suffering from high blood pressure, the Ministry of Health has stated.

title: Sri Lanka expresses concern over treatment of “Global Sumud Flotilla” detainees
byline: The Government of Sri Lanka has expressed deep concern over footage posted by Israeli Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir, which appears to depict the dehumanizing treatment of detainees linked to the “Global Sumud Flotilla.”

title: Cardinal Ranjith hits out at politicians over hypocrisy, broken promises and moral decline
byline: The Archbishop of Colombo His Eminence Malcolm Cardinal Ranjith, says he is deeply disappointed by the conduct of politicians in the country.

title: CAA announces estimated price ranges for several essential food items
byline: The Consumer Affairs Authority (CAA) has announced the estimated retail price ranges for several essential food items for the week from May 18 to May 24, 2026.

title: Harry Styles tour ‘actively working’ on staging after fan complaints
byline: Harry Styles’ world tour is set to review its staging following complaints from fans over obstructed views.

title: UN votes to support strong action on climate change despite US efforts to thwart the effort
byline: The U.N. General Assembly voted overwhelmingly Wednesday to support strong action to limit climate change despite recent diplomatic efforts by the United States to have the measure withdrawn.

title: Police to implement special security program during Vesak Week
byline: A special island-wide security program will be implemented during the Vesak week to ensure devotees can observe religious activities in a peaceful and secure environment, the Police headquarters has announced.

title: Sri Lanka’s inflation climbs to 4.7% in April
byline: The overall inflation rate in Sri Lanka, as measured by the National Consumer Price Index (NCPI) on a year-on-year (YoY) basis, increased to 4.7% in April 2026 from 2.4% recorded in March 2026, according to the Department of Census and Statistics.

title: Police issue guidelines on action to take after mobile phone loss or theft
byline: Sri Lanka Police say complaints regarding lost, misplaced and stolen mobile phones are reported daily to police stations across the country, warning that such devices can be misused if they fall into the wrong hands.

title: Iran’s Supreme Leader says enriched uranium must stay in Iran – report
byline: Iran’s Supreme Leader has issued a directive that the country’s near-weapons-grade uranium should not be sent abroad, two senior Iranian sources said, hardening Tehran’s stance on one of the main U.S. demands at peace talks.

title: Harsha raises alarm over potential rate hike and economic impact
byline: The Central Bank of Sri Lanka (CBSL) may raise interest rates by at least 50 to 100 basis points next week, equivalent to an increase of 0.5% to 1%, Samagi Jana Balawegaya Member of Parliament Harsha de Silva told Parliament today (21).

title: PM Harini meets Sri Lankans residing in London
byline: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya, who is currently on an official visit to the United Kingdom, has met with members of the Sri Lankan community living in London, yesterday (20), and engaged in cordial discussions.

title: More than Rs. 1 trillion in tax revenue collected - IRD
byline: The Inland Revenue Department (IRD) has announced that it has collected over Rs. 1 trillion in tax revenue as of May 18, 2026.

title: Record 274 climbers scale Mount Everest in a single day from Nepali side
byline: A record number of 274 climbers scaled Mount Everest on Wednesday, a hiking official said, the highest number ever to reach the world’s tallest peak on the same day from the Nepali side.

title: UNP raises concerns over rupee depreciation, questions govt’s economic approach
byline: The United National Party (UNP) has raised concerns over what it described as the “uncontrolled depreciation” of the Sri Lankan rupee, questioning the government’s economic approach and warning of rising pressure on the public due to the increasing cost of living.

title: India-Africa Forum Summit postponed in wake of Ebola virus outbreak
byline: The Ebola public health emergency in Africa cast its shadow on India’s diplomatic calendar with the Ministry of External Affairs on Thursday (May 21, 2026) announcing postponement of the India-Africa Forum Summit-IV that was scheduled for May 28-31.

title: Sports Minister approves new selection committee for Sri Lanka Cricket
byline: The Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports says that it has approved the members nominated for the new Selection Committee of Sri Lanka Cricket (SLC).

title: 79-year-old woman found murdered, body concealed in suitcase in Seeduwa
byline: The body of a 79-year-old woman, who is suspected to have been gruesomely murdered, has been discovered stuffed inside a suitcase at her residence in the Seeduwa Police area.

title: Subcommittee appointed to probe environmental impact of Norochcholai Power Plant
byline: A subcommittee has been appointed by the Sectoral Oversight Committee on Environment, Agriculture and Resource Sustainability to investigate the environmental impact caused by the Norochcholai Lakvijaya Power Plant and to submit recommendations.
